anomalies (lost update, write skew) using a dependency-graph check.

# one attempts to write -- this forces the transactions to overlap in time.

    # explicitly. Separate connection per thread (SQLite connections are
    # not safe to share across threads).

                       f"COMMIT rejected (stale snapshot): {exc}; "
                       f"rolled back, no units reserved",

                        add_edge(a, b, f"wr({ITEM_KEY}): {b} read "
                                       f"reserved={r_b} written by {a}")
                    if ta > tb and r_b == before_a:
                        add_edge(b, a, f"rw({ITEM_KEY}): {b} read "
                                       f"reserved={r_b}; {a} overwrote it")

                for tb, _bb, _ab in writes_of(b):
                    if ta < tb:
                        add_edge(a, b, f"ww({ITEM_KEY}): {a} wrote before {b}")
                    elif tb < ta:
                        add_edge(b, a, f"ww({ITEM_KEY}): {b} wrote before {a}")

    print(f"item_id={ITEM_ID} quantity={quantity} reserved={reserved}")

    main()
